description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model during the fine-tuning process over a series of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from approximately 25 to 70, with tick labels at regular intervals. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is solid with square markers, the tiny line is dashed with square markers, the tiny int4 line is dotted with circle markers, the tiny int8 line is dash-dot with square markers, and the tiny full line is dotted with triangle markers. All lines show a general decline in WER as the number of epochs increases, with the tiny AdaLoRA_int4 configuration starting at the highest WER and ending at the lowest, indicating the best performance. The other configurations follow a similar downward trend, with the tiny full configuration starting at the lowest WER and ending at the highest, indicating the least improvement over the epochs.
